decisions.reason: As a customer-facing airline app that sits farther from the firm's core security-service advantage, it likely has weaker differentiation and lower remaining option value by 2022 than the resources it ties up.

Passenger processing technology fits the firm's airport-security core, supports its innovation-led positioning, and still offers option value under uncertain post-launch market development at manageable carrying cost.

A self-service airline check-in solution is adjacent to the firm's established airport operations and may still be worth keeping as a medium-cost option while demand and rollout potential continue to clarify.
